newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamato Transport seen posting larger profit-paper.
newsitem.headline: Yamato Transport seen posting larger profit-paper.

text.p: Yamato Transport Co Ltd is expected to post parent current profit of 23 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1997, and mark the seventh straight year of rises in current profit, a Japanese paper said on Thursday.

The expected 1996/97 current profit is eight percent higher than that of a year ago, and about 500 million yen higher than the company's profit forecast announced earlier this year, economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
The paper said its estimate was due to unexpectedly robust demand for door-to-door parcel delivery services. Yamato officials were not immediately available for comment.
